description: Configure email forwarding for the user 'sarah' on the domain 'acmecorp.test'. Forward all incoming emails to 'sarah.hr.backup@gmail.com'. CRITICAL: You must ALSO ensure that a copy of every email is delivered to Sarah's local mailbox on the server (do not disable local delivery). You can find the user in the Virtualmin 'Edit Users' list for the acmecorp.test virtual server.
